gun_shield_rules: Fits a weapon's Gun Shield Mount attachment. It works as a Bulletproof Shield (mods and Tech Upgrades included), but only while that weapon is held two-handed and you haven't moved more than 4m/yds on foot this Round. Deploy or retract it as an Action, or while stowing the weapon or setting up a Bipod; deployed, the weapon can't be concealed. A destroyed Gun Shield is gone for good, and fitting a new one takes 1 minute.
enhancement_rules: Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.

shield_rules: Shield Attachments and Enhancements follow the Armor Attachment and Enhancement rules, but for Bulletproof Shields, including cyberware ones; not for vehicle Bulletproof Glass. Corgo's optional rule: a Bulletproof Shield with HP left puts its wielder in Cover and counts as a 2x2m/yds piece of Cover against Suppressive Fire, which they may share with one adjacent character.
